name: yipyap-language
description: Provider-neutral YipYap learning with supported-host session bootstrap and a bounded account connector.

interface.longDescription: Public YipYap (Language) read-first release with supported-host fresh-session bootstrap and one shared language Skill. Its bounded connector reads verified account settings and teaching context; missing or unverified state fails closed to L0.
defaultPrompt: Use $yipyap-language to show my current YipYap (Language) setup status.
Use $yipyap-language to explain how YipYap (Language) levels work.
Use $yipyap-language to check whether YipYap (Language) is connected.
